mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPI YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO drops > 2% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 300,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real final sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both increase, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a potential pause in tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases during a tightening cycle, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
